snippet.title: Freeze a Potato, Thank Me Later
snippet.description:
*Ingredients:*
2 potatoes
Oil 
Salt 
Black pepper (optional)
Cajun power (optional)

*Instructions:*
1. Place whole raw potatoes in the freezer overnight.
2. The next day, thaw them in water until completely defrosted.
3. Once soft, squeeze out as much water as you can.
4. Peel the skin and split the potatoes in half.
5. Brush with oil and season with salt, pepper, and Cajun powder.
6. Air fry at 390°F (200°C) for about 15 minutes, or until golden and crisp.

snippet.title: My classmates risked DETENTION for ME?!
snippet.description:
My classmates risked DETENTION for ME?!

✨Recipe:
Ingredients:
• 1 lb pasta of choice
• 2 tbsp cornstarch
• 3 tbsp butter
• 3 tbsp flour
• 1 can (12 oz) evaporated milk
• 1 ½ cup heavy cream
• ½ lb mozzarella
• ½ lb velveeta
• 6 oz gruyere
• ½ lb sharp cheddar
• ½ lb smoked gouda
• ½ lb colby jack
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tsp pepper
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp onion powder
• 1 tsp cayenne pepper
• 1 tsp smoked paprika
• 1 tsp mustard powder

Directions:
1. In a large sized bowl shred all the cheeses and coat with cornstarch.
2. Boil your noodles until slightly underdone and set aside.
3. In a large pan on medium low heat, melt the butter before whisking in the flour until combined. Add the spices and stir to combine.
4. Whisk in evaporated milk then heavy cream little bits at a time. If you pour it all at once it could break the sauce or curdle.
5. Small amounts at a time, whisk in half of your grated cheese.
6. Add your noodles into your bechamel sauce and combine well.
7. In a 9x13 baking dish, place half of the noodles/sauce, then half the remaining shredded cheese. Add the other half of the noodles/sauce and then the remaining cheese.
8. Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes.
9. Remove from the oven and let rest for about 5 more minutes, then serve and enjoy! 😊
